purpose: Give the visitor/member-facing GitHub business site a polished, modern wow factor using restrained glow, pulse, motion and department identity without becoming distracting or inaccessible.
principles: effects never obstruct reading or navigation
accessibility and reduced-motion preferences are respected

ask_henry.button_effect: soft perimeter glow with occasional slow pulse
ask_henry.attention_state: brief halo pulse when contextual help is useful

primary_actions.effect: subtle breathing halo only when the action deserves attention
primary_actions.rule: Do not animate every button simultaneously.

department_cards.effect: soft under-glow beneath card or department header
department_cards.hover: gentle lift, edge illumination and shallow depth change
department_cards.identity: Each department may have a restrained visual accent while sharing one enterprise design language.

page_details: gentle reveal on first viewport entry
light sweep reserved for rare featured announcements
motion_limits: no effects that interfere with text contrast
no motion required to understand content
experience_goal: Visitors should notice that the site feels advanced and alive without feeling like a gaming interface, advertisement wall or distracting light show.
